articles.title: A Prank Device Name Triggers a Midair U-Turn: How 'BOMB' on Bluetooth Sent a Flight Back to Newark
articles.summary: A United Airlines flight to Spain reversed course after a passenger's Bluetooth speaker appeared as 'BOMB.' The crew treated it as a security threat, evacuating the plane and inspecting it. The flight arrived 9.5 hours late, sparking debate about pranks and safety.

articles.title: Anthropic Files for IPO, Setting Stage for a Trillion-Dollar AI Debut
articles.summary: AI giant Anthropic, maker of Claude, has confidentially filed for a U.S. IPO. Valued at $965 billion, it's racing rivals OpenAI and SpaceX to public markets. The move could reshape stock indexes and test investor appetite for AI.

articles.title: Hungary's PM Moves to Amend Constitution, Oust President in Power Struggle
articles.summary: Prime Minister Péter Magyar is launching a constitutional amendment to remove President Tamás Sulyok, an Orbán appointee. Magyar calls Sulyok a 'puppet' and says he obstructs democratic functioning. The president refuses to resign, setting up a legal clash.
